author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices steady beat, high and low, loud and soft, stop and go, word rhythm and playing together, on a snowy sleigh ride.

classes.title: Trot like the sleigh horse
classes.goal: Feel the steady beat of the sleigh ride with gentle knee trots.

mathTarget.parentLine: Feeling something that comes again and again, evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Sit your child on your knees and trot gently on every beat, like a horse.
classes.childAction: Ride, clap and shake your hands like bells.
classes.bridge: The beat is the horse's hooves: clip, clop, clip, clop through the snow.

intro.caption: Let's ride the snowy sleigh
intro.parentCue: child on your knees, trot gently

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: feeling the steady beat, together.

classes.title: Hooves on the keys
classes.goal: Tap one steady tap for every beat while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each beat, no more, no less

classes.parentPrompt: Rest your hand over your child's hand and tap together, then slowly let go.
classes.childAction: Tap any key once for each beat. Any key is right.
classes.bridge: Each beat is one hoof in the snow; one tap for each clop.

intro.caption: One beat, one clop
intro.parentCue: tap your child's shoulder on each beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each beat.

classes.title: Bear low, bird high
classes.goal: Hear low and high sounds and tap the matching side of the piano.

mathTarget.parentLine: Low sounds live on the left, high sounds on the right

classes.parentPrompt: Crouch and growl for the bear; stretch up tall and chirp for the bird.
classes.childAction: Bear sound: tap the left side. Bird sound: tap the right.
classes.bridge: Low notes are a heavy bear in the snow; high notes are a tiny bird.

intro.caption: Bear lives low, bird lives high
intro.parentCue: point left for the bear, right for the bird

games.caption: Bear! Big snowy bear
games.parentCue: Growl together, then tap the left side

games.caption: Bird! Tiny winter bird
games.parentCue: Chirp together, then tap the right side

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing high and low sounds.

classes.title: Big bells, tiny bells
classes.goal: Tap the beat with big loud taps, then with tiny soft taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: Noticing big and small: the same tap, more or less

classes.parentPrompt: Make strong arms for loud taps; whisper and tiptoe your fingers for soft ones.
classes.childAction: Loud: big bell taps. Soft: tiny tinkly taps.
classes.bridge: Loud taps are a big bell ringing; soft taps are snowflakes landing.

intro.caption: Big bells, tiny snowflakes
intro.parentCue: loud means strong arms, not banging

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing loud and soft.

classes.title: Slow horse, fast horse
classes.goal: Follow the music as it slows like a turtle and speeds like a bunny.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same tune, same shape, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Trot your child on your knees, slowly then quickly, matching the music.
classes.childAction: Turtle music: slow taps. Bunny music: quick taps.
classes.bridge: Slow taps are a tired horse walking; fast taps are a horse galloping.

intro.caption: Turtle slow, bunny fast
intro.parentCue: slow down if the taps get wild

games.caption: Bunny time: fast sleigh!
games.parentCue: Same tune, now quick and light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: following slow and fast music.

classes.title: Whoa, horse! Freeze!
classes.goal: Tap while the music plays and freeze when it stops.

mathTarget.parentLine: When the sound stops, the hands stop too

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'whoa!' and freeze with a funny face when the music stops; cheer when it restarts.
classes.childAction: Tap while music plays. Freeze like a statue when it stops.
classes.bridge: Music on, the horse trots; music off, 'whoa', the sleigh stands still.

intro.caption: Go, horse, go! Whoa, freeze!
intro.parentCue: make your freeze silly, like a statue

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: listening for stop and go.

classes.title: Jin-gle: two taps
classes.goal: Tap once for each piece of a word, like jin-gle, two taps.

mathTarget.parentLine: One tap for each piece of a word you sing

classes.parentPrompt: Say the words slowly and tap your child's hand once for each word piece.
classes.childAction: Jin-gle: two taps. Bells: one big tap.
classes.bridge: Each word piece is one hoofprint in the snow: jin, gle, bells.

intro.caption: Jin-gle: one, two taps
intro.parentCue: say jin-gle slowly and tap twice

games.caption: Jin-gle bells, jin-gle bells
games.parentCue: Say each word piece with each light

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one tap for each word piece.

classes.title: Guess the sleigh game
classes.goal: Listen and switch between games: high and low, loud and soft, fast and slow.

mathTarget.parentLine: Sorting each sound: high or low, loud or soft?

classes.parentPrompt: Pause before each picture and ask: bear or bird? Loud or soft? Then cheer.
classes.childAction: Guess the game, then tap high, low, loud, soft, slow or fast.
classes.bridge: Every sound wears a costume: bear, bird, big bell, snowflake, turtle or bunny.

intro.caption: What game is it?
intro.parentCue: let your child guess first; any guess is fine

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: telling sounds apart and switching games.

classes.title: Sleigh ride duet
classes.goal: Make the song together: the grown-up plays the tune, the child keeps the beat.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two different jobs fit together to make one song

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and watch your child; if they stop, keep playing and smile.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat on any key while your grown-up plays the tune.
classes.bridge: The tune is the sleigh; your beat is the horse that pulls it.

intro.caption: I play, you tap
intro.parentCue: sit side by side at the piano

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing one song together, two jobs.

classes.title: Sleigh concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song from start to end, then cheer and bow together.

mathTarget.parentLine: A song starts, goes on, and ends; we finish together

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play the tune, then clap, cheer and bow together.
classes.childAction: Tap the beat to the very end, then take a big bow.
classes.bridge: The song is a sleigh ride: off we go, through the snow, and home.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
